app.name: EyeBar
timer.custom.title: Timer
timer.custom.label: Minutes:
timer.dismiss_hint: Click the cat to silence the alert
notes.title: Notes
standby.hint: Double-click the background or press Esc to exit
settings.title: EyeBar Settings
settings.city: Weather city (choose or type your own)
mascots.cyber_cat.desc: A detailed fluffy seated cat with clock eyes and a temperature patch on its fur.
mascots.neon_ghost.desc: A calm levitating ghost. Floats, blinks and shows the time.
settings.emotions_hint: The selected emotion is saved and restored at startup. Music triggers dancing when normal emotion is selected. The mini cube now shows the temperature as stitching on the mascot itself.
settings.glass_hint: Changes take effect after Save. On Windows 10/11, frosted and liquid materials request native blur where supported. The highlighted rim is an original EyeBar effect, not literal background refraction. Capture exclusion cannot be guaranteed for every application.
settings.hotkey_invalid: Invalid hotkey. Use a supported key (letter, digit, F1–F24, arrow, etc.) with Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win.
settings.save_error: Could not save settings. Changes were not applied.
launcher.launch_failed:
Could not open the pinned file:
{path}
settings.follow_cursor: Follow cursor with eyes (except angry, sad and sleepy)
settings.widgets_hint: Drag rows or use arrows to reorder. Uncheck to hide. Custom commands run only on click, without a command shell. The mini cube uses a centered mascot without a separate weather badge.
mascots.luna_bunny.desc: A calm seated rabbit with a screen face and long ears.
mascots.byte_fox.desc: A sly seated fox with a big tail and a screen face.
settings.city_placeholder: Start typing a city or choose one from the list
quick.unavailable: This feature is unavailable on this computer.
quick.saved: Screenshot saved and copied to clipboard: {path}
alarm.title: Alarms
alarm.editor_hint: Select an alarm to edit it. The checkbox enables/disables it. Click New to add an alarm.
alarm.repeat: Repeat on weekdays (none selected = one time):
alarm.save_failed: Could not save the alarm. Check its time and the settings folder.
alarm.limitations: Works only while EyeBar is running and Windows is awake. A powered-off or normally sleeping PC will not sound the alarm.
alarm.ringing_body: Alarm set for {time}. Snooze for 5 minutes or stop.
night.power: Allow Windows power saver plan (with consent)
night.hint: Night mode dims the app and lowers decorative animation FPS; it does not control monitor brightness or guarantee a silent PC. Windows power plan changes require consent.
night.power_confirm: Allow EyeBar to switch Windows to the power saver plan when night mode starts? EyeBar will try to restore the previous plan when night mode ends. Windows/hardware support varies. Allow?
mascots.classic_blue.desc: EyeBar’s blue cat: a neon outline and a digital clock display.
settings.classic_blue_default_hint: Select Classic Blue when EyeBar starts. You can switch to any character during the session.
weather.error_network: No connection or weather service unavailable
weather.error_response: Could not read the weather service response
alarm.sound_required: Choose a WAV file for the custom sound.
alarm.audio_hint: WAV volume is adjustable. If the audio backend is unavailable, the system beep uses system volume. 0% mutes all alarm sound.
notes.conflict_saved: Another window saved newer notes. Your text was saved to {path}
notes.recovery_failed: Could not save a recovery copy; this editor keeps your text
